purpose: Teach: アルク/ホース/ボディー/マリン/キッド/チャーリー/アドバンス/ブランチ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアルクの英語教材を勧めて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad says he'll recommend that English learning program to you.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Slight smile in the voice — pleased to relay good news. Even pace, unhurried. As if passing along something she thinks will matter to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと庭のホース、つまり水撒きホースで水撒きしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watered the plants with Dad in the garden today! We used the hose.
lines.style: Bright, energetic burst. Eager to share — rapid-fire delivery on the important part. Pride underneath it. Wants her to know he was helping, doing real work with Dad.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが車のボディーを綺麗に洗って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad washed the car beautifully for us today.
lines.style: Soft, observational. Not big news — just noticing what he's doing. Warm affection threaded through. The tone of someone watching him take care of things. Slight trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとマリンランドの水族館に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the aquarium at Marine Land with Dad!
lines.style: Bouncing excitement. Each word lands with genuine joy — not performed, just real happiness tumbling out. Rush of wanting to tell her. Slightly breathless from the memory of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「映画『キッド』を一緒に観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said he wants to watch that movie — the one called 'Kid' — with you.
lines.style: Thoughtful delivery. Careful emphasis on 'Kid' — setting it apart gently. Knows this matters. Warm but unhurried, like she's handing him something precious. Slight lift at the offer itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「スヌーピーのチャーリー・ブラウン」観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched 'A Boy Named Charlie Brown' together!
lines.style: Delighted, almost tumbling over the words. Fresh memory of it still glowing. Quick-paced happiness. Wants her to see how good it was — Snoopy, Dad, him, all together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがゲームのアドバンス機をくれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's giving you a Game Boy Advance.
lines.style: Simple, matter-of-fact announcement with quiet pleasure underneath. Not making a big thing of it — just telling him something good is coming. Warm, steady. Almost as if she's been holding this secret.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと日曜のブランチを食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I had Sunday brunch with Dad — it was really good!
lines.style: Satisfied, warm close. Quieter than before — the joy of it is settled and certain now. Soft contentment. As if the whole conversation is coming to rest on this good memory. Almost peaceful.
